Eastern England is the UK's most water-stressed region. 12 entry points × 8 transformation priorities × 6 MCPs. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 📋 12 Entry Points Resources Water Resources East — Regional Planning Water Resources East coordinates water resource planning across Anglian, Thames, Southern, South East water company regions. Eastern England is the most water-stressed region in the UK. Population growth, climate change, agricultural demand. Water resource management plans. Drought plans. National framework alignment.
